newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco delists Spanish Uniban bank from bourse.
newsitem.headline: Morocco delists Spanish Uniban bank from bourse.

text.p: Morocco has delisted Spanish Uniban bank after it was absorbed by leading Moroccan Wafabank, a bourse official said on Tuesday.
"Uniban was delisted last week from the stock exchange quotation to comply with the agreement details signed with Wafabank," the official said.
Wafabank purchased 100 percent of Uniban's capital, or more than 2.46 million shares at $28 million, a Wafabank spokesman said.
Wafabank offered one share in exchange for five shares of Uniban despite some opposition from minority shareholders, their spokesman said.
The Moroccan bank showed a net profit of 242 million dirhams ($25.7 million) in calendar year 1996, up 20 percent over the 201 million dirhams in 1995.

A private local group owns 50.4 percent of Wafabank. Another 10.4 percent, previously held by French Groupe Suez, was ceded last year to Indosuez bank group. The remaining 39.2 percent of Wafabank equity is publicly owned.
At present, the number of listed stocks on the 68-year old bourse stands at 47, brokers said.
